summary: Fixes findToolController so that creating an operation from a script in a Job with several tool controllers and no GUI selection no longer raises UnboundLocalError and instead assigns the last tool controller in the Job; also replaces lazy DraftGeomUtils/TechDraw imports with direct Part curve checks (internal only).

pages.reason: PathScripts/PathUtils.py findToolController: in console mode with multiple tool controllers and no name, now returns controllers[-1] (last tool controller in the Job) instead of crashing; docstring changes 'first controller' to 'last controller', so any note on which tool controller a scripted Create() picks should say the last one in the Job, and that the tree selection only applies when no name is passed
PathUtils.py changes are internal helper code (import cleanup, reverseEdge using Part.Circle/Part.Line isinstance, unused-variable renames); nothing in the workbench overview page describes them

meta.title: CAM: Fix findToolController for console mode
